# My Property Fact

> My Property Fact is a trusted real estate platform offering LOCATE scores, expert tips, verified property insights, and market trends to help buyers and investors make smarter decisions.

My Property Fact provide expert blogs, project details, and transparent information across India, simplifying property search and empowering users with reliable knowledge.

Canonical domain: `https://mypropertyfact.in/`
Primary market: India
Language: English

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://mypropertyfact.in/): Primary landing page with featured projects and service overview.
- [Projects Page](https://mypropertyfact.in/projects): Primary project discovery page.
- [Blog](https://mypropertyfact.in/blog): Real estate insights, trends, and investment articles.
- [Commercial Projects](https://mypropertyfact.in/projects/commercial): Explore premium commercial properties including office spaces and retail shops designed for business growth and high investment returns.
- [New Launches](https://mypropertyfact.in/projects/new-launches): Discover the latest real estate launches featuring new residential and commercial projects with modern amenities and attractive investment opportunities.
- [Residential Projects](https://mypropertyfact.in/projects/residential): Browse residential properties including luxury and affordable homes designed for modern living with quality construction and top amenities.
